rules.title: Source of lawful income protection in housing
rules.quote: The LAD also prohibits housing discrimination based on the source of lawful income or source of lawful rent or mortgage payment a tenant or purchaser uses. This means, for example, that a landlord cannot deny the lawful recipient of a Section 8 HUD voucher the right to rent an apartment based solely on that source of lawful income.
rules.summary: Landlords cannot discriminate against tenants based on their source of lawful income, including Section 8 vouchers.
rules.coverage_text: applies to the sale or rental of all property including open land, whether for business or residential purposes, with exceptions for owner-occupied two-family dwellings (rental of single unit), rooms in owner-occupied one-family dwellings, and certain religious organization preferences
rules.exemption_note: Does not apply to rental of single apartment in owner-occupied two-family dwelling or room rental in owner-occupied one-family dwelling
rules.penalty: Complaint may be filed with Division on Civil Rights within 180 days or in Superior Court within 2 years; may result in administrative hearing and remedial orders
